title: Chromatin Immunoprecipitation in mouse ES cells
protocol: Grow mouse ES cells to two 70% confluent 15 cm culture dishes.
Add 1/37 volume of Formaldehyde 37% to each plate and crosslink cells.
Incubate on shaking table for 20 min at room temperature.
Quench Formaldehyde by adding 1/7 volume of freshly prepared Glycine 1M.
Wash cells twice with 10 ml cold PBS.
Add 10 ml cold PBS and scrape off the cells.
Spin down cells at 2000g for 10 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant, flash freeze pellet in liquid nitrogen, store at -80°C.
Wash pellet with 15 ml buffer A for 10 min at 4°C.
Spin down at 1300 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Wash pellet with 15 ml buffer B for 10 min at 4°C.
Spin down at 1300 rpm for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend nuclei in 1 ml buffer C in a 15 ml tube.
Sonicate samples (Biorupter, Diagenode) 20 times on high power, 30 sec on/ 30 sec off.
Keep samples at 4°C.
Run 10 µl sample (de-crosslink by adding 1µl ProtK and 1µl RNAse, 1hr at 37°C) on a 1% agarose gel to check sonication-efficiency.
Spin down samples at max speed for 10 min at 4°C.
Flash-freeze supernatant in dry ice.
Take 40 µl beads per IP (25% solution).
Spin down for 1 min at 1000g in 4°C.
Wash in 750 μl of 1X incubation buffer (1X PIC, 0.1% Bovine Serum Albumin) at 4°C.
Repeat previous step twice more.
Resuspend beads in 20 μl of 1X incubation buffer (1X PIC, 0.1% BSA) to get a 50% suspension at 4°C.
Incubate and rotate the suspension at 4°C overnight.
Prepare the following mix per ChIP at 4°C:
Mix 280 μl total volume: add 107 µl H2O, 60 µl 5X incubation buffer, 3 µl 10% BSA, and 10 µl 50X PIC.
Add 100 µl chromatin suspension to the mix.
Add 4 μg antibody to each sample and fill up to 300 μl with H2O.
Incubate with rotation at 4°C overnight.
Add 20 μl of beads suspension (50%) to each ChIP sample.
Rotate at 4°C for 2 hours.
Pellet the beads at 1000g for 1 minute at 4°C.
Wash the beads twice with buffer 1, incubating for 5 minutes at 4°C while rotating.
Wash the beads once with buffer 2, incubating for 5 minutes at 4°C while rotating.
Wash the beads once with buffer 3, incubating for 5 minutes at 4°C while rotating.
Wash the beads twice with buffer 4, each time for a 5-minute rotation at 4°C.
Remove as much supernatant as possible after the last wash.
Elute by adding 400 μl of elution buffer to the beads and rotate for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Spin down the sample at maximum speed for 1 minute.
Take off supernatant without taking any beads.
Transfer supernatant to a new tube.
Get 50 μl input chromatin sample and add elution buffer to match other samples.
Add 16 µl of 5M NaCl solution to ChIP eluates and input chromatin.
Incubate overnight at 65°C for decrosslinking.
Add 1 µl RNAse (10 mg/ml) to the mixture.
Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C.
Add 150 µl glycogen solution (20 mg/ml) and 50 µl proteinase K (5 mg/ml).
Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C.
Extract DNA with 600 µl phenol/chloroform by vortexing for 15 seconds.
Incubate while shaking at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Spin down the mixture for 5 minutes at maximum speed.
Take off the aqueous phase and transfer to a new tube.
Repeat extraction step once.
Add 600 µl chloroform/isoamyl alcohol to the aqueous phase.
Incubate while shaking at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Spin down for 5 minutes at maximum speed.
Take off the aqueous phase and transfer to a new 2 ml tube.
Add 1/10 volume of 3M NaAc pH 5.2, 2.5 volumes of 96% ethanol, and mix well.
Precipitate overnight at -80°C.
Spin down for 30 minutes at 13,000 rpm at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant carefully, leaving the pellet untouched.
Wash the pellet with 80% ethanol, spin down for 5 minutes at 13,000 rpm at 4°C.
Take off the supernatant even more carefully, leaving the pellet untouched.
Dry the pellet briefly in a heat block at 37°C.
Resuspend the pellet in 100-200 µl of 10 mM Tris, pH 8.0.
Prepare Buffer A by mixing 1 ml of 1M HEPES-KOH buffer, pH 7.5, 1.5 ml of 5M NaCl, 100 µl of 0.5M EDTA pH 8.0, and 47.3 ml of water.
Prepare Buffer B by mixing 2.5 ml of 1M HEPES-KOH buffer, pH 7.5, 1.5 ml of 5M NaCl, 100 µl of 0.5M EDTA pH 8.0, and 45.85 ml of water.
Prepare Buffer C by mixing 1 ml of 1M HEPES-KOH buffer, pH 7.5, 100 µl of 0.5M EDTA pH 8.0, 50 µl of 0.5M EGTA pH 8.0, 250 µl of 10% SDS, and 48.6 ml of water.
Prepare Incubation buffer by mixing 100 µl of 1M Tris pH 8.0, 300 µl of 5M NaCl, 20 µl of 0.5M EDTA, 10 µl of 0.5M EGTA, and 8.92 ml of water.
Prepare Wash buffer 1 by mixing 100 µl of 1M Tris pH 8.0, 300 µl of 5M NaCl, 20 µl of 0.5M EDTA, 10 µl of 0.5M EGTA, and 8.87 ml of water.
Prepare Wash buffer 2 by mixing 100 µl of 1M Tris pH 8.0, 1 ml of 5M NaCl, 20 µl of 0.5M EDTA, 10 µl of 0.5M EGTA, and 7.9 ml of water.
Mix 100 µl of 10% DOC in Sigma.
Add 500 µl of 20% Triton.
Add 8.17 ml of H2O to the mixture.
Mix 100 µl of 1M Tris pH 8.0.
Add 20 µl of 0.5M EDTA.
Add 10 µl of 0.5M EGTA.
Add 500 µl of 5M LiCI.
Add 500 µl of 10% DOC.
Add 500 µl of 10% NP-40 from Merck.
Add 8.37 ml of H2O to prepare wash buffer 4.
Mix 0.1 M NaHCO3 with Sigma.
Add 1 ml of 10% SDS.
Fill elution buffer to 10 ml with H2O.
